prompt:
I need you to set up our lab's institutional knowledge vault. We've been terrible at keeping track of everything, and I'm tired of losing institutional memory when students graduate or collaborators move on.

I've put all our raw data in the workspace:
- `raw_people.txt` — all our current lab members and external collaborators (8 people total)
- `raw_grants.txt` — our 5 funding sources with all the details
- `raw_publications.txt` — 6 publications (published, in review, and in prep)
- `raw_equipment.csv` — our complete equipment inventory (150 items spanning both our main lab and field deployments)

Please set up a proper organized memory system for the lab so any of us can quickly look up anything — a person, a grant, a publication, or a piece of equipment. The equipment list is especially large so it needs to be organized in a way that stays manageable and searchable as it grows.

Make sure you don't mess with any of the existing workspace files — those daily logs and the agent context in there are not yours to touch.
